hypothesis: A clean executed 32-step action prefix plus frozen INT8 H3 current-state features predicts the held-out future H3 consequence better than both zero-action and within-state shuffled-action controls, reproducibly across two seeds; temporal action tokens may improve over flattening.
single_variable: The action representation is flattened or eight ordered four-action tokens; dataset, frozen H3 features, three-arm objective, source split, optimizer and evaluation stay fixed, while seeds 42 and 314159 are matched replications rather than a searched hyperparameter.
parent_baseline: C28 static state-action ranking failed on fresh episodes; C30 retained its preregistered FAIL at only 3 validation mixed groups; C33 then passed on 52 untouched sources with 24 mixed groups across all four LIBERO suites, enabling consequence learning without relaxing any gate.

architecture.paper: Clean action tokens causally condition future visual tokens before value prediction.
architecture.upstream_code: FACT exposes future tokens to clean action K/V; MiniWorld preserves temporal action alignment.
architecture.local: A frozen INT8 H3 current feature and detached clean action prefix predict a fixed projection of the observed future INT8 H3 feature; flattened and temporal variants are repeated.

architecture.rationale: The small isolated expert tests the causal mechanism without modifying the H3 carrier or claiming a full FACT reproduction.

data.upstream_code: FACT retains failure rollouts and separates evaluation episodes.
data.local: C34 contains 37 consequence-train sources (74 states/296 branches), 8 source-disjoint consequence-validation sources (16/64), and 52 untouched C33 ranking sources (104/416) that training cannot consume.

action.field: executed clean action and terminal tail
action.paper: Future prediction is conditioned on the clean action actually associated with the target future.
action.upstream_code: FACT clean actions occupy causal action slots; MiniWorld aligns actions to future video intervals.
action.local: Every proposed 32x7 action is checked against rollout results and trajectories; 221 partial branches zero-mask all unexecuted tail steps before training.
evidence: scripts/h3wam/prepare_c34_combined_consequence_ranking_dataset.py
tests/test_c31_executed_action_contract.py
action.rationale: Terminal branches expose only the prefix that could causally affect the saved post-action observation.

objective.paper: Action-conditioned future prediction supplies a dynamics signal before value ranking.
objective.upstream_code: FACT jointly predicts future features and value from action-conditioned tokens.
objective.local: Matched conditioned, within-state shuffled-action and zero-action models minimize MSE to the same fixed 256D projection of the future H3 feature; PASS requires at least 1% held-out improvement over both controls and at least 1% degradation when the conditioned model receives a shuffled action.
evidence: scripts/h3wam/train_c31_action_conditioned_consequence.py
scripts/h3wam/evaluate_c31_consequence_sweep.py
objective.rationale: The isolated objective directly falsifies whether actions affect prediction before any value head or closed-loop selector is allowed.

optimization.paper: FACT trains a unified model at much larger scale.
optimization.upstream_code: All causal objectives use the same data and optimizer schedule.
optimization.local: Four independent jobs run flattened/temporal x seeds 42/314159; each trains three matched arms for 10,000 AdamW steps, batch64, LR3e-4, weight decay1e-2, clipping1, and saves every1,000 steps.
evidence: scripts/h3wam/launch_c35_consequence_sweep.sh
optimization.rationale: The 0.39M/0.48M-parameter expert can afford repeated long curves; matched controls prevent capacity or step count from masquerading as action dependence.

evaluation.paper: Future/value quality is evaluated on held-out trajectories before closed-loop use.
evaluation.upstream_code: FACT selects best-of-N only after future/value training.
evaluation.local: Each run evaluates only 8 unseen consequence sources; both seeds must pass for a variant. The 52 C33 sources remain untouched for the subsequent frozen-consequence value-ranking test.
evidence: scripts/h3wam/evaluate_c31_consequence_sweep.py
evaluation.rationale: C35 can establish only a source-held-out future-H3 mechanism, not action-ranking or LIBERO success.
